detailed_descriptions.en: Football Life Simulator lets you live the life of a professional footballer, on and off the pitch. The city is one connected place now. Walk its streets or buy a car and drive across it. Train with your team, play your matches and climb the career ladder, then spend what you earn on cars, a home, nights out and the people around you. The further you rise, the more there is to lose. Drive across a living city instead of picking a destination off a menu. Turn chances into goals, lift the crowd and climb your way up the league. Walk out of the tunnel on match day, with the cameras and the noise waiting for you. Sharpen your shooting, dribbling and technique in hands-on training mini-games. Drink, gamble and stay out late. Then find out how your body feels about it tomorrow. Build the player you want to be, down to the haircut and the watch. Open World City: One connected city to walk and drive through, with a full day and night cycle. Cars and Driving: Buy cars at the dealership, drive them across town, park them and keep them in your garage. Comprehensive Career Mode: Start your football career from scratch and reach the top. World Cup and Tournaments: Play through national and international tournaments with a full bracket. 50+ In-Match Scenarios: Moments that come up mid-match, and the calls you make on them. Life Path Selections: Forks in the road that shape how your career and your life go. Trainings: Improve your shooting, dribbling, positioning and technique with hands-on sessions. Injuries and Treatment: Manage treatment processes in case of injuries and fight to return to the field. Stats and Conditions: Hunger, energy and mood all catch up with you the next day. Earnings and Gainings: Manage what you make, control your expenses and make it count. Shopping and Character Customization: Customize your look, from the hairdresser to accessories and watches. NPC Interactions: Build friendships and romances with the people around you. Cutscenes and Goal Celebrations: Locker room, tunnel walkout, and the moments after the ball goes in. Relics: Rare finds worth hunting down. Phone Camera with Poses: Take photos around the city and strike a pose. Your Phone: Call services, order food and keep up with everything from your pocket. Home Decoration: Use your earnings to decorate and personalize your living space. TV, Radio, and Magazine Content: Relax at home with various TV channels, radio programs and magazines. Gambling and Entertainment: Try your luck at casinos and other entertainment around the city. Press Conferences: Boost your reputation by answering questions during press conferences. Mini-Games: Polished minigames scattered across town.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Football Life Simulator lets you live the life of a professional footballer, on and off the pitch.

The city is one connected place now. Walk its streets or buy a car and drive across it. Train with your team, play your matches and climb the career ladder, then spend what you earn on cars, a home, nights out and the people around you. The further you rise, the more there is to lose.



Drive across a living city instead of picking a destination off a menu.





Turn chances into goals, lift the crowd and climb your way up the league.





Walk out of the tunnel on match day, with the cameras and the noise waiting for you.





Sharpen your shooting, dribbling and technique in hands-on training mini-games.





Drink, gamble and stay out late. Then find out how your body feels about it tomorrow.





Build the player you want to be, down to the haircut and the watch.
